retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist monochromatic layout featuring centered bold serif typography with a subtle gradient effect against a flat pastel background.
triggerTerms: centered bold serif text on flat background
minimalist album art with advisory label

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a solid pastel pink field. The focal point is a single line of centered, wide-set serif text that utilizes a subtle horizontal color gradient. A small, high-contrast rectangular graphic element is positioned in the bottom right corner to ground the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic harmony between text and background
Symmetrical balance centered on the horizontal and vertical axes
High contrast between the main pastel field and the black-and-white corner element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary text is dead-center, occupying approximately 30% of the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The centered text acts as the primary anchor, while the bottom-right rectangle provides a secondary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the center text and drops to the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space (over 80%) emphasizes the minimalist aesthetic.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lighter pink to white gradient for text fill
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black and white for the corner graphic
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value (pastel) for the majority of the frame.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to shades of pink, black, and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for the main title, contrasted by a sans-serif functional label in the corner.
graphicDevices: Solid rectangular border for corner label

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, high-contrast serif look
Provides a similar classical but modern expanded feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid, flat pastel pink square background with a small black and white 'Parental Advisory' style rectangle in the bottom right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay centered, bold, expanded serif text in uppercase. Apply a subtle horizontal gradient to the text ranging from light pink to white.

verificationChecks: Is the background a single flat pastel color?
Is the font an expanded serif?
Is the corner label high-contrast black and white?

mustRedesign: Do not use photographic textures in the background
postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the pastel background
Ensure the corner graphic does not overlap the main text
Verify the monochromatic pink palette is maintained
Confirm the serif font is sufficiently wide/expanded
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Pastel Background + Centered Expanded Serif + Bottom-Right High-Contrast Label
